notes.title: June game update
notes.notes:
This update incorporates more Chinese elements and adds three new Chinese city airports: Taiyuan Wusu International Airport, Nanjing Lukou International Airport, and Zhengzhou Shangjie Airport.

notes.title: The first major update of Triumph in the Skies!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, after a long time of production, Triumph in the Skies will be the first major update since its release at 10 am on April 10. 
This update adds more scenes and more tracks, and of course there are other surprises waiting for you to discover!

Scene update:
In the Quick Start, two airports with Chinese characteristics were updated, namely Beijing Capital International Airport with a 20-year history and Beijing Daxing International Airport, which was officially opened in September 2019.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146314/3df248567b0a0ab78855f025b071fb736b10b02f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146314/c2ef8e4e08243f7387d076cff7519946618eeeb4.jpg

Track update:
In Aerobatic FLT of Racing Mode, four new tracks were updated, which are located in Hong Kong, China, Singapore, Tokyo, Japan, and London, England.

notes.title: Commemorate discounts for the first big update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, after a long time of production, Triumph in the Skies has ushered in the first major update since its release.

This update adds more scenes and more tracks, and of course there are other surprises waiting for you to discover!

To commemorate the first major update, a special commemorative discount was launched. The discount date: 10:00 am on April 10, 2020-10:00 am on April 24, 2020, 50%off, come and download to start your VR flying experience！
